measures.title: Aiken County wastewater treatment facilities authority
measures.summary: Aiken County was authorized to acquire, construct and operate wastewater treatment facilities in referendums held in 1976 and 2006. This question asks whether to modify that authority so the county may provide wastewater services both within and outside Aiken County and use funds from any source permitted by law for that purpose.
measures.yesMeans: Aiken County's wastewater authority would be modified to allow services within and outside the county, paid for with funds from any lawful source.
measures.noMeans: Aiken County's existing wastewater authority from the 1976 and 2006 referendums would stay as it is.
